root_cause: Merged PR #4075 changed a canonical Supabase migration. The migration was APPLIED in production, but the post-merge terminalizer depended on a machine-readable PR marker that no canonical owner produced for migrations. It failed with SUPABASE_MIGRATION_PROVIDER_READBACK_MISSING even though the provider later showed the exact migration as applied. Manual marker writeback plus failed-job rerun closed the incident, proving the missing piece was migration evidence ownership rather than runtime correctness.
prevention: Make the existing post-merge obligation terminalizer the single owner for migration provider readback; do not widen the Edge production authority or introduce a second scheduler.
Run migration readback only for trusted merged PRs in the production environment, using the existing Supabase access token and GitHub token.
Query Supabase Management API migration history with bounded retries and require exact migration version plus exact migration name.
Write the canonical Terminal-Supabase-Migration-Readback marker to the merged PR before terminal evidence is evaluated.
Keep the terminalizer fail-closed when the exact migration never appears in provider history.
Never treat repository presence, preview success or migration filename alone as production proof.

evaluation.expected: The single post-merge terminalizer proves the exact migration from provider history, writes the canonical APPLIED marker, consumes that marker in the same lineage, and remains fail-closed if the provider never proves it.
